headline: Kazakhstan-US Bilateral Trade Rises 24% to $2.89 Billion in Nine Months
summary: Bilateral trade turnover between Kazakhstan and the United States reached $2.89 billion in the first nine months of 2026, marking a 24.0% increase year-on-year.
why: Expanding bilateral trade volumes signal strengthening economic and commercial ties between partner nations.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Increased bilateral trade turnover contributes positively to economic activity.
